answer_1.quote: We work on the task of sentence ordering, wherein given an unordered set of sentences, the aim is to generate the most coherent ordering among them...
answer_1.outputs: Coherently ordered sequences of sentences (reordered paragraphs)

answer_2.quote: We employ the following five metrics to evaluate our approach. ... Perfect Match Ratio (PMR), Sentence Accuracy (ACC), Kendall's Tau (TAU), Rouge-S (R-S), Longest Common Subsequence (LCS).
